headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally to Multi-Month Highs Driven by Record FII Inflows and Banking Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex jumped 898 points to cross 25,800 led by gains in banking and IT sectors.
Indian stock market extended a four-week rally as foreign institutional investors (FIIs) drove record buying.
Banking stocks supported market recovery pushing Nifty Bank to a record high.
Earlier global volatility stemming from Fed rate hike cues and AI tech sell-offs eased.
whatHappening: Tata Steel announced a ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo Tubes for two units.
PNB Managing Director clarified that ECL provision requirement of around ₹5,000 crore will not impact profitability.
Federation of Indian Pilots wrote to the Civil Aviation Minister regarding the ongoing SpiceJet crisis.
FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri over unsafe water samples.
summary:
Indian share markets surged higher with Sensex gaining nearly 900 points to cross 25,800, supported by record FII buying and banking sector strength.
Key corporate deals highlighted the session, including Tata Steel's ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo Tubes and PNB's positive outlook on ECL provisions.
Meanwhile, SpiceJet remains under scrutiny as the pilots' federation approached the Civil Aviation Minister regarding its operational crisis.
